common.serverUnreachable: Could not reach the server. Try again.
common.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts — try again in a minute.

channelHint.in_store: Customers earn cashback at your counter.
channelHint.online: Customers earn cashback on orders placed online.
channelHint.both: Customers earn cashback at the counter and online.

auth.loginSubtitle: Sign in with your merchant account
auth.noStoreYet: Want to offer cashback at your store?

signup.title: Create your store
signup.subtitle: Offer cashback to customers across the Maldives
signup.phoneInvalid: Enter a Maldivian mobile number, e.g. +9607XXXXXX.
signup.phoneHint: We'll text you a 6-digit code to verify this number.
signup.codeInvalid: That code is not right. Check the SMS and try again.
signup.codeAttemptsExceeded: Too many wrong codes. Request a new one.
signup.verificationExpired: Your verification expired. Start again with your mobile number.
signup.businessNamePlaceholder: Your store's name, as customers see it
signup.businessNameRequired: Enter your business name (at least 2 characters).
signup.emailAlreadyRegistered: This email already has a merchant account. Sign in instead.
signup.afterSignupNote: Next you'll set up your store profile — it goes live once Manfaa approves it.

setup.title: Set up your store
setup.subtitle: Complete these steps, then submit your store for review
setup.ownerOnlyBody: Only the store owner can complete the setup wizard. Ask the owner to finish setting up the store.
setup.profileSubtitle: How your store appears to customers
setup.categoryHint: Pick the category that best matches your store — customers browse by it.
setup.contactHint: Shown on your public store page so customers can reach you.
setup.logoSubtitle: Shown on your store page and on discovery cards
setup.logoHint: JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 2 MB, between 64 and 4096 pixels per side. You can add or change it later.
setup.logoInvalidType: Use a JPG, PNG or WebP image.
setup.logoTooLarge: That image is over 2 MB — pick a smaller file.
setup.rateSubtitle: The percent of each eligible sale your customers earn
setup.rateFormatError: Enter a percent with up to two decimal places, e.g. 7.50.
setup.rateMaxError: The highest rate available right now is {{max}}.
setup.rateRangeHint: Percent of the eligible amount, up to two decimal places. Allowed range {{min}} to {{max}}.
setup.ratePreviewNote: Fee bands: up to 0.99% cashback → 0.25% fee · 1–1.99% → 0.5% · 2–4.99% → 0.75% · 5% and up → 1%. The platform's fee schedule confirms the exact fee.
setup.termsSubtitle: Tell customers what part of the bill earns cashback
setup.termsPlaceholder: e.g. Cashback on the food total, excluding service charge and delivery.
setup.termsGuidance: Displayed to customers exactly as written. Say what counts and what doesn't — service charge, delivery, gift cards, tobacco… It mirrors your agreement and is never used in computation.
setup.termsRequired: Write your cashback terms before continuing.
setup.reviewSubtitle: Check everything, then send your store to Manfaa for review
setup.reviewNoLogo: No logo — you can add one later
setup.reviewSubmitNote: After you submit, Manfaa reviews your store. It becomes visible to customers only after approval.
setup.pendingTitle: Your store is being reviewed by Manfaa
setup.pendingBody: We're checking the details you submitted. You'll be able to use the merchant panel as soon as your store is approved.
setup.rejectedBody: Manfaa reviewed your store and sent it back with a note:
setup.notEditable: The setup can't be changed right now — refresh to see the latest status.

roles.ownerHint: Everything — including the bank account, staff accounts and API access.
roles.managerHint: Runs the shop — cashback rate, promotions, settlements, branches and product categories. No bank account, staff accounts or API access.
roles.staffHint: Credits customers at the counter and reads the screens — changes no settings.
roles.inviteHint: You can change this later on this screen.

gate.ownerBody: Only the account owner can change this. Ask the owner of {{store}} if something here needs to change.
gate.managerBody: This screen is for managers and the account owner. Ask a manager at {{store}} if something here needs to change.

settings.profileSubtitle: What customers see about your store
settings.renameNote: Renaming the business is an identity change — contact Manfaa to update it.
settings.logoSubtitle: Shown on your public store page and discovery cards
settings.categoryHint: Curated list — customers browse stores by category.
settings.channelHint: Controls where you appear in the customer app's discovery sections.

productCategories.title: Product categories
productCategories.subtitle: Set different cashback for product types. Anything not listed earns your standing rate.
productCategories.empty: No product categories yet — every sale earns your standing rate. Add one to exclude it or give it its own rate.
productCategories.nameDvHint: Optional — shown to customers and staff using Dhivehi.
productCategories.modeRateHint: Sales in this category earn their own cashback percent.
productCategories.modeExcludedHint: Sales in this category never earn cashback — even during promotions.
productCategories.rateHint: Percent of the line amount, up to two decimal places. Allowed range {{min}} to {{max}}.
productCategories.ratePercentInvalid: Enter a percent with up to two decimal places, e.g. 2.50.
productCategories.sortHint: Lower numbers appear first in lists.
productCategories.deactivateBody: New sales can no longer be split into this category — anything not listed earns your standing rate. Past sales keep the rate they were priced at. You can reactivate it any time.

creditSplit.toggleHint: Optional — split this sale into your product categories so each part earns its own rate.
creditSplit.editorHint: Split the eligible amount across categories. The line amounts must add up to the eligible amount exactly.
creditSplit.amountInvalid: Enter a valid amount of at least MVR 0.01.
creditSplit.mismatchTitle: The lines don't add up to the eligible amount.
creditSplit.mismatchBody: Difference: {{difference}}. Adjust the line amounts (or the eligible amount) until they match — the credit can't be recorded otherwise.
creditSplit.duplicateCategory: This category is already on another line.
creditSplit.unknownCategory: This category is no longer available — pick another.
creditSplit.rateUnknown: Rate preview unavailable — the server still prices this line correctly.
creditSplit.excludedNote: This part earns no cashback — even during promotions.
creditSplit.promoBeats: The live promotion beats this line's own rate ({{own}}).
creditSplit.previewNote: Estimate — each line is priced separately on the server at the sale time; a promotion's per-customer cap may reduce promo-priced lines.

settlement.title: New settlement
settlement.subtitle: Pay your outstanding cashback and fees, then upload your transfer receipt
settlement.settleSomeHint: Pick the sales you are paying for now.
settlement.emptyPayable: Nothing to settle right now — payable transactions appear here once their validation window closes.
settlement.selectAtLeastOne: Pick at least one transaction, or choose to settle everything outstanding.
settlement.reviewLead: Transfer this exact amount from your bank, then upload your receipt on the next step. Nothing exists until you do — these transactions stay payable in the meantime.
settlement.creditAppliedHint: Credit notes from earlier adjustments, netted off this batch.
settlement.referenceHint: Quote this on the transfer — it is how we recognise your payment.
settlement.referencePreviewNote: This reference is assigned when you submit your receipt. If the settlement then shows a different one, that is the reference of record.
settlement.noAccountTitle: Transfer details are not published yet
settlement.noAccountBody: Contact Manfaa for the account to pay into. Nothing is lost — come back and submit your receipt once you have transferred.
settlement.walletShort: Not enough to cover this settlement.
settlement.walletSettleFailed: Could not settle from your wallet.
settlement.nothingDueTitle: Your credit covers this in full
settlement.nothingDueBody: There is nothing to transfer. Confirm, and these transactions close against your credit.
settlement.uploadLead: The receipt is what creates the settlement — Manfaa checks it against the transfer before your customers' cashback confirms.
settlement.dropzone: Drag your receipt here, or click to choose a file
settlement.dropzoneHint: JPEG, PNG, WebP or PDF — up to 5 MB
settlement.fileTooLarge: That file is over 5 MB. Photograph the slip again at a smaller size, or upload the bank's PDF.
settlement.fileUnsupported: Receipts must be a JPEG, PNG, WebP or PDF file.
settlement.bankRefHint: The reference or transaction number your bank shows for this transfer.
settlement.bankRefRequired: Enter the reference from your bank.
settlement.amountHint: Exactly what left your account — change it only if you sent a different amount.
settlement.amountInvalid: Enter the amount you transferred, e.g. 1,250.00.
settlement.amountUnder: Less than the amount due. We allocate oldest-first: whatever this does not cover stays payable on this settlement until you pay the rest.
settlement.amountOver: More than the amount due. The surplus becomes wallet credit towards your next settlement.
settlement.duplicateBankRef: You have already submitted a receipt with this bank reference. Check the reference on your bank slip, or open the settlement it belongs to.
settlement.notEligible: Some of these transactions are no longer payable. Go back and choose again.
settlement.successBody: Settlement {{reference}} is with our team. We check your slip against the transfer, then your customers' cashback confirms. Nothing else is needed from you.
settlement.listSubtitle: Batches of outstanding cashback and fees you have settled or are settling
settlement.emptyList: No settlements yet — build one from your outstanding transactions.
settlement.statusVerifyingBody: We're checking your slip against the transfer. Your customers' cashback confirms as soon as it matches.
settlement.statusRejected: Manfaa could not verify your transfer
settlement.statusRejectedBody: This settlement is cancelled and its transactions are payable again. Create a new one with the correct receipt.
settlement.statusSettled: Settled — the rewards on this batch are confirmed.
settlement.statusPartiallySettled: Part of this batch is settled; the rest is still owed.
settlement.statusAwaitingPaymentBody: Manfaa built this batch for you. Transfer the amount due, then upload your receipt here.
settlement.statusCancelled: This settlement was cancelled; its transactions are payable again.
settlement.remainderBody: This batch is still short {{amount}}. Its transactions stay frozen here until it is paid in full — transfer the rest, then upload that receipt.
settlement.receiptAdded: Receipt submitted — Manfaa is verifying it.
settlement.settledTitle: Settled — the rewards on this batch are confirmed
settlement.settledBody: Settlement {{reference}} is closed and funded from your wallet. Nothing else is needed from you.

credit.backdatedTitle: Backdated sale — this credit is final
credit.backdatedBody: This sale is older than your refund window — once credited it cannot be reversed, and it becomes payable to Manfaa immediately.
credit.backdatedMaybeBody: This sale may be older than your refund window. If it is, once credited it cannot be reversed, and it becomes payable to Manfaa immediately.
credit.backdatedConfirm: I understand: this credit cannot be reversed and is payable now.
credit.backdatedConfirmRequired: Confirm you understand before recording this credit.
credit.backdatedResultBody: This backdated sale skipped the refund window. The customer's cashback is payable to Manfaa immediately, and neither you nor your POS can reverse it — contact Manfaa if it needs correcting.
credit.scanBody: Point the camera at the QR code in the customer's Manfaa app.
credit.scanDenied: Camera access is blocked. Allow the camera in your browser settings, or type the 6-digit code.
credit.scanNoCamera: No camera is available on this device — type the 6-digit code instead.
credit.scanFailed: Could not start the camera. Type the 6-digit code instead.
credit.scanUnreadable: That code isn't a Manfaa customer code. Ask the customer to open their Manfaa app, or type the 6-digit code.
credit.scanManualHint: You can always type the code by hand.
